x0_mass_mechanism.gauge_operator: -(1/f^2) e^(-3Hy) (e^(3Hy) u')' = m^2 u on [-L, 0] (each half of the cell), u'(0) = 0, e^(-3HL) u'(-L)/f^2 = c_tip u(-L)
x0_mass_mechanism.leading_mass: m^2 = c_tip / int_{-L}^0 e^(3Hy) dy = 3 H c_tip/(1 - e^(-3HL))
x0_mass_mechanism.c_tip: W: g5^2 v_Sigma^2 w_tip/4; Z: (g5^2 + g5'^2) v_Sigma^2 w_tip/4; photon, gluons: 0
x0_mass_mechanism.fermion_block: h = -(i/f) sigma1 d_y + mu sigma2 (+ kappa k sigma3 + v for k != 0), zero modes (e^(f mu y), 0) and (0, e^(-f mu y))
x0_mass_mechanism.fermion_mass: m_f = lambda_f zeta(mu_L) zeta(-mu_R), zeta(mu)^2 = 2 f mu e^(-2 f mu L)/(1 - e^(-2 f mu L))
x0_mass_mechanism.uncertainty: flat line: <p^2> >= 1/(4 Delta s^2) (saturated by a Gaussian); warped cell: m^2 = <p^2> + (3H/2f)^2 - (3H/f) rho(fold) + (3H/f) rho(tips) + tip field, so m >= hbar/(2 c Delta s) for the odd modes and the excitations only (ANALYSIS.md)

dirac16complex_kohn_sham_with_portals.block: h_j = j[-(i/f) sigma1 d_y + M_eff(y) sigma2 + kappa k sigma3] + v_v(y) (Revision/kohn_sham/ks-theory.json)
dirac16complex_kohn_sham_with_portals.M_eff: m + (15/16) lambda S(y) + g_S sum_f s_f delta_tip(y) + g_D sum_f m_f s_f(y)
dirac16complex_kohn_sham_with_portals.v_v: -(1/16) lambda n(y) + g_V sum_f q_f n_f(y)
dirac16complex_kohn_sham_with_portals.sources: n_f(y) = n_f |chi_f(y)|^2 (the Standard-Model fermion densities in their x0 zero modes), s_f the scalar densities; g_V = c_V/Lambda_D^6, g_S = c_S/Lambda_D^6, g_D = c_D/Lambda_D^7 (P1, P2, P5); P3 and P4 have no mean field in a neutral, unpolarised, Sigma = 1 background and act through scattering only
dirac16complex_kohn_sham_with_portals.back_reaction: m_f -> m_f + g_S S_Psi(-L) zeta_L zeta_R + g_D m_f <S_Psi>_f; the Standard-Model vector potentials shift by g_V q_f n_Psi(y); the gravitational source is the total T^M_N
dirac16complex_kohn_sham_with_portals.energy: the portal energy density g_V n_Psi sum_f q_f n_f + g_S S_Psi s_SM is counted once in the total energy
